faqs.q: Who is eligible to apply for the First Home Buyers Assistance scheme?
faqs.a: You must be an individual (not a company or trust), at least 18 years old. You, or at least one person you are buying with, must be an Australian citizen or permanent resident. You or your spouse must not have previously purchased a home or vacant land, and you must have already exchanged contracts to purchase your first home or vacant land.

faqs.q: What documents do I need to apply?
faqs.a: You need the 'First Home Buyers Assistance Scheme Application' PDF form, the Purchaser/Transferee Declaration (individual) PDF, your proof of identity, the agreement for sale or transfer, and any other supporting documents.

faqs.q: How do I apply for the scheme?
faqs.a: First, select the ‘Download PDF form’ button and complete the application form. Next, download and complete the Purchaser/Transferee Declaration (individual) PDF. Finally, lodge the completed forms and supporting documents with your solicitor or conveyancer.
